plateau.reason: On the official ICLR discrete scale, R39 and R40 both score 6/6/6. R40 materially closes the declared per-call attention artifact/configuration and GDN eager-route provenance boundary and improves the story, but the score remains capped by live-object binding, strong-baseline incremental value, and production-like scheduling/cost. Further prose-only revision cannot address these gaps.
